title: HF propagation prediction surface v1
description: Batch-published nowcast/forecast of HF path-cell openness and SNR. Columnar encoding: every array under `columns` has exactly `n_cells` elements; element i across all columns describes one path-cell. Per-horizon columns are arrays of `n_cells` arrays, each of length `horizons_s.length`. Consumers MUST ignore unknown additional properties (additive evolution is allowed within v1). See docs/SPEC-contract-notes.md.

generated_at.description: UTC time the surface was generated.

valid_from.description: Start of the 15-minute window this surface's h=0 predictions describe (UTC, minute in {0,15,30,45}).

valid_until.description: Time after which consumers MUST treat the surface as stale (normally valid_from + 30 minutes).

trained_through.description: Last UTC date of training data.

reference.description: Conditions all predictions are normalized to.

cell_scheme.description: Path-cell granularity: 2-character Maidenhead fields, directional tx->rx.

snr.description: SNR values are FT8-equivalent dB: 2500 Hz noise reference bandwidth, normalized to 100 W (50 dBm) transmit power per SPEC-labeling.md section 4.4.

horizons_s.description: Forecast horizons in seconds from valid_from, ascending. v1 canonical set: [0, 3600, 10800, 21600, 43200, 86400].

n_cells.description: Number of path-cells; the length of every array in `columns`.

p_open_pct.description: Calibrated P(open) as integer percent, one inner array per cell with one entry per horizon. null = model abstains for that horizon.

snr_db_ft8eq_p50.description: Median expected SNR (FT8-equivalent dB, integer) per cell per horizon. null where P(open) is low or the SNR model abstains. Optional column.

confidence.description: Data-density tier per cell: 0=low, 1=medium, 2=high. Computed from training-data label density for the cell (train folds only).
